materialText.title: Sample Plant Observation Notes
materialText.content: Page 1: Two similar seedlings were observed for seven days. One received regular light and one remained in a dark box. Page 2: The seedling with regular light remained green and grew steadily. The seedling in darkness became pale and weak.

materialSummary.title: Light and Seedling Growth Observation
materialSummary.overview: A controlled observation compares two similar seedlings exposed to different light conditions over seven days.

usableFragments.content: Two similar seedlings were observed for seven days under different light conditions.
The seedling in regular light remained green while the seedling in darkness became pale and weak.

riskNotes: The notes describe an observation but do not provide measurement values.

warnings: Do not present the observations as quantitative evidence.
